user.title: Set up Hakanban
user.description: This adds the Hakanban Kanban board to Home Assistant. There is nothing to configure — boards, columns and cards are managed from the Hakanban panel in the sidebar.

init.title: Name and icon
init.description: How Hakanban appears in the sidebar and above the board. Leave a field blank to use the default.

error.title_too_long: The name can be at most 40 characters.
error.invalid_icon: Use an icon name like mdi:hammer-wrench.

move_card.name: Move card
move_card.description: Move a card to another column.

update_card.name: Update card
update_card.description: Update fields on an existing card.
